question: India is ranked _______ in the World Happiness Report published in March 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**118th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **World Happiness Report 2025**, published in **March 2025**, **India ranked 118th** among **147 countries**.
 
• The report is published annually by the **Wellbeing Research Centre at the University of Oxford**, in partnership with **Gallup**, the **UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (SDSN)**, and the **editorial board of the World Happiness Report**.
 
• The rankings are based on people's self-assessed life evaluations and factors such as **GDP per capita, social support, healthy life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perceptions of corruption**.
 
• **Finland** retained the **1st position** for the **eighth consecutive year** in the 2025 report.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3 – 118th**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Top 5 Countries in the World Happiness Report 2025:**

 
 
• 1. Finland
 
• 2. Denmark
 
• 3. Iceland
 
• 4. Sweden
 
• 5. Netherlands
 
 
 
• **Purpose of the Report:**
 
 
• It measures the happiness and well-being of people across countries using survey data and socio-economic indicators.
 
 
 
• **Release:**
 
 
• The report is released annually on or around the **International Day of Happiness (20 March)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Rank (World Happiness Report 2025):** **118th**.
 
• **Total Countries Ranked:** **147**.
 
• **Top-ranked Country:** **Finland** (8th consecutive year).
 
• **Published By:** Wellbeing Research Centre, University of Oxford, in partnership with Gallup, SDSN, and the World Happiness Report editorial board.
 
• **Released:** March 2025 (around 20 March – International Day of Happiness).
